backup_procedure: Create an encrypted backup in an approved external location with least-privilege access and retention policy.
Record per-file relative path, byte size, SHA-256, purpose, dependencies, owner and backup location in a restricted manifest.
Do not delete or move the LXC originals as part of backup.
Periodically restore to an isolated directory, verify SHA-256, run SQLite/ZIP integrity checks, and record restoration evidence.
